notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]First big update to Skeletery is here! [/h1]
[h3][list]
[*]31 Steam Achievements have been added to the game. Can you unlock all of them?
[*]QoL change: increased Level 1 start currency (i.e. bones). Now it should be easy to start playing and purchase the first building.
[*]QoL change: added hint message whenever you have enough bones to purchase a building.
[*]QoL change: fixed knights health regeneration so they do not feel OP to kill.
[*]QoL change: added hint message whenever you try to place a building while standing in a building location.
[*]Fixed a bug where placing a building while standing in same location caused a falling through a map.
[*]Fixed bugs with audio such as humans' SFX disconnected from global audio and default sound settings set to zero.
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.notes:
[h1]Unfortunately, Skeletery release has been delayed.[/h1]
[h3][list]
[*]If you saw the game trailer, you might have known that game was planned to be released on Halloween.
[*]However, this is no longer the case, and the game needs more time to be polished and ready for the release.
[*]The release date has been moved to further date, but it is still coming soon, and the announcement will be made whenever it is ready!
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: Important Updates
notes.notes:
Skeletery went through several updates lately, and I wanted to share that with you:
[list]
[*]Skeletery is part of Steam Next Fest, meaning that you can play [b]Free Demo[/b] of the game if you haven't already done so!
[*]Skeletery supports [b]Linux[/b]! We had some very kind playtesters that tested the game on Linux platform, including Steam Deck! Share this news with your Linux gamers, and spread the word!
[*]After some consideration, the game will be released as [b]full release[/b] instead of early access. The game will be ready to play with planned gameplay and designed levels.
[*]The game page has some new in-game screenshots, and more will be added soon! I hope to create a new trailer as well that captures new levels, among other things.
 [/list]

notes.title: Second Playtesting!
notes.notes:
[h1]Playtesting from August 18 to August 20![/h1]
[h3]Sign up will be available on Skeletery page on Friday afternoon (European time)![/h3]

[b]Important details[/b]
[list]
[*]Playtest will run from August 18 to August 20.
[*]Playtest will have open signup, so as soon the playtest starts, you can download and play the game!
[*]Playtest is for alpha version of the game, meaning basic gameplay features and sample level to try.
[*]Playtest includes a need to defend the cemetery, fight humans, place buildings in exchange for human bones, and survive human waves!
[*]Building placement provides you with buffs that improve your chances to survive until the end of the level.
[*]Playtesters who share feedback will receive nice surprises upon game release!
[/list]

During and after the playtest, make sure to submit your feedback through the [url=https://discord.gg/q4fMrU9m]Discord channel[/url] or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2228430/]Skeletery's Steam community[/url].

Let me know (via Discord channel or Steam's community) if you have any issues getting into the playtest, and I'll help to solve it.

notes.title: New Trailer & Screenshots!
notes.notes:
Skeletery has been in progress for some time, and I'm happy to announce a new trailer & screenshots!

The trailer shows the updated gameplay and the setup in which your skeleton gets to defend the cemetery.
The trailer demonstrates game mechanics such as melee fights, building placement & creation, and more!

Playtesting will be available soon and Skeletery will also be participating in a few upcoming Steam events, so stay tuned!
